payload.notes: Policy-compliant four-B70 record for the frozen 0xSero DeepSeek V4 Flash uniform-K160 checkpoint. Xe2 MHC kernels were made directly XPU-command-graph compatible by replacing oneAPI's unsupported work-group scratch-memory extension with ordinary local accessors; vLLM no longer breaks the FULL decoder graph around MHC. Graph construction fell from 23s to 3s, while realistic decode improved modestly from 10.0161 to 10.0903 tok/s (+0.74%). All 12 unique cold prompts reported cached_tokens=0; arithmetic, exact-copy, Paris, and strict-JSON canaries passed. No speculation or reuse. K160 remains an experimental hash-pruned smoke/performance artifact, not an official-source quality-certified final pack.
